_meta.source: Distilled from references 01-06,10-12 (PlacePlate guides, creator ecosystem, Mayer/Sweller/Alley/Duarte/Minto/Knaflic).

techniques.name: Duplicate-and-Morph (core workflow)
techniques.steps: Duplicate slide > edit copy only > select copy > Transitions > Morph > Preview/tune duration 0.8-1.2s

techniques.name: !! Forced-morph naming
techniques.steps: Selection Pane > rename both partner objects to identical !!name on both slides > Morph forces match across types

techniques.name: Travelling element
techniques.steps: Same !! shape repositioned/resized on every slide -> continuous glide through deck

techniques.name: Off-canvas exit (never delete)
techniques.steps: Drag exiting objects outside slide edge on next slide instead of deleting

techniques.name: Zoom-in hero reveal
techniques.steps: Object small slide N > full-bleed N+1 > Morph = camera zoom

techniques.name: Expanding navigation dots
techniques.steps: One dot -> row of !!nav-dot-i on agenda slide; reuse with active index as progress tracker

techniques.name: Animated data (duplicate + new values)
techniques.steps: Duplicate chart slide, change values; same chart object interpolates (M365). Fallback: !! rectangle bars

techniques.name: Cinematic text (Words/Characters)
techniques.steps: Effect Options > Words or Characters; title travels center->corner

techniques.name: Scrolling infographic / one-canvas pan
techniques.steps: Build oversized scene across canvas edges; each duplicate shifts group; Morph pans camera

techniques.name: 3D model rotation morph
techniques.steps: Same 3D model both slides, rotate on 2nd, Morph spins live (M365)

techniques.name: Photo un-crop / Ken Burns push-in
techniques.steps: Crop tight on N, relax crop on N+1 (works on video objects too)

techniques.name: Blur/color state shift
techniques.steps: Duplicate; change brightness/blur/fills on copy; Morph cross-grades scene

techniques.name: Morph logo reveal
techniques.steps: Photo bg + 40% black mask + logo cut-out (Merge Shapes Subtract) > duplicate > scale huge > Morph

techniques.name: Rotation/spin motif
techniques.steps: Wheel rotated 30-45deg per duplicate, center pinned; Morph = spin

techniques.name: Image slider strip
techniques.steps: Card strip overflowing canvas; shift one card per duplicate; center card scales up

techniques.name: Progress/counter walk
techniques.steps: Duplicate advancing fill/number one step each; Morph all
techniques.generator_support: native via agenda; manual for counters

techniques.name: Slide/Section/Summary Zoom hub
techniques.steps: Insert > Zoom on hub slide; click dives to section, auto-returns

techniques.name: Trigger pop-ups
techniques.steps: Animations > Trigger > On Click Of [button] reveals hidden content same-slide

techniques.name: Kiosk mode loop
techniques.steps: Set Up Show > Browsed at a kiosk: keys dead, hyperlinks only, loops

techniques.name: Parallax layers
techniques.steps: 2-3 bg layers move different distances across Morph duplicates = depth

techniques.name: Masked emergence
techniques.steps: Object animates behind slide-bg-filled foreground shape -> emerges from edge/card

techniques.name: Book flip (3D rotation states)
techniques.steps: Page shape through 3D rotation key states + Morph between

techniques.name: Merge Shapes surgery
techniques.steps: Union/Combine/Fragment/Intersect/Subtract for motifs, masks, cut-out text

techniques.name: SVG icon recolor
techniques.steps: Insert Icons or paste SVG > Convert to Shape > ungroup > theme fills

techniques.name: Ctrl+D transform repeat
techniques.steps: Duplicate once with offset, then Ctrl+D repeatedly repeats transform -> instant grids

recipes.name: Agenda / progress tracker
recipes.content_limits: <=6 items x <=6 words; active=index for progress

recipes.name: Chart + insight rail
recipes.content_limits: 1 series focus; 1 accent bar; axis at 0

structures.name: Investor pitch deck
structures.sequence: R1 title > R4 problem > R4/R5 solution > R10 market > R4 product > R5 model > R8/R9 traction (move early if strong) > R6 GTM > R7 competition > R11 team > R8 financials > R13 ask

structures.name: Academic / thesis defense
structures.sequence: R1 > R2 outline > R4 intro > R5 research questions > R6 methodology > R8/R9 results x2-3 > R4 conclusion > references > backup slides

structures.name: Business / company profile
structures.sequence: R1 > R2 > R4 who we are > R8 market problem > R5 services > R6 process > R8+R9 proof > R12 case quote > R7 differentiation > R16 logos > R11 team > R6 roadmap > R13

structures.name: Sales / proposal
structures.sequence: R1(client-branded) > R4 their situation > R9 cost of inaction > R5 solution > R6 plan > R8 outcomes > R12 proof > R7 why us > R7 pricing > R4 risks > R13 next steps

structures.name: Seminar / training / keynote
structures.sequence: R1 > R9 hook > R2 > per section [R3 + R4 concept + R8 example + recap] > R5 synthesis > R13 resources

structures.name: Business review (QBR)
structures.sequence: R1 > R14 exec stats > R8 KPI stories x4-6 > R4 misses&causes > R6 initiatives > R13 decisions needed

structures.name: Executive decision deck
structures.sequence: cover > SCQA exec summary (R4) > one R8 per MECE argument > R7 options > R13 recommendation+owners/dates

principles.name: Coherence
principles.generation_rule: Delete everything not serving the message (seductive details out)

principles.name: Signaling
principles.generation_rule: Cue the essential: one accent element, bold key terms, preview headlines

principles.name: Redundancy
principles.generation_rule: Never print your script and read it; visuals + voice only

principles.name: Spatial contiguity
principles.generation_rule: Labels on/next to chart elements; kill legends

principles.name: Temporal contiguity
principles.generation_rule: Reveal visual and narration together

principles.name: Segmenting
principles.generation_rule: Chunk content; paced sections; one idea per slide

principles.name: Pre-training
principles.generation_rule: Define key terms before the complex model

principles.name: Modality
principles.generation_rule: Explain complex visuals by voice, not paragraphs

principles.name: Multimedia
principles.generation_rule: Words + relevant pictures > words alone

principles.name: Image principle (null)
principles.generation_rule: Decorative speaker images don't aid learning — spend pixels on evidence

principles.name: Split-attention effect
principles.generation_rule: Integrate mutually-dependent text+diagram physically

principles.name: Redundancy effect (CLT)
principles.generation_rule: If visual is self-explanatory, repeating it in text hurts

principles.name: Transient information
principles.generation_rule: Dense animation overloads; leave final state visible

principles.name: Working-memory limit ~3-4
principles.generation_rule: Max 3-4 new interacting elements per view; rule-of-3 arguments

principles.name: Assertion-Evidence advantage
principles.generation_rule: Sentence headline (assertion) + visual evidence body, no bullets
principles.evidence: 110 students: better comprehension (d~0.60 dynamic), fewer misconceptions, better 1-week recall

principles.name: More words != more learning
principles.generation_rule: Cut slide text; bullet group saw +73% words, remembered no more

principles.name: Presenter benefit
principles.generation_rule: Building assertion-evidence slides deepens presenter's own understanding

principles.name: Picture superiority
principles.generation_rule: Distinctive content-bearing visuals beat words (dual coding); generic stock loses the edge
principles.evidence: Paivio 1971+; word+picture ~2x recall in classic tests

principles.name: Von Restorff isolation
principles.generation_rule: One different element against homogeneous set gets remembered — one isolate per context

principles.name: Peak-end + serial position
principles.generation_rule: Invest in opening, peak (STAR), and closer; end on the ask

principles.name: Perception ranking
principles.generation_rule: Position > length > angle > area: bars beat pies

principles.name: Data-ink / chartjunk
principles.generation_rule: Erase non-data ink; small multiples > spaghetti

principles.name: Contrast minimums
principles.generation_rule: Text >=4.5:1 (3:1 large); graphics >=3:1; never color-only encoding

principles.name: Okabe-Ito palette
principles.generation_rule: CVD-safe categories: E69F00 56B4E9 009E73 F0E442(fills) 0072B2 D55E00 CC79A7 000000; still check contrast separately

principles.name: Learning Pyramid retention % (10% read...90% do)
principles.generation_rule: NEVER cite: Dale's 1946 cone had no numbers; % are 1967 folklore, data nonexistent

principles.name: Mehrabian 7-38-55 communication
principles.generation_rule: Only measured like/dislike under inconsistent cues; invalid for informational talks; author disclaims

principles.name: Learning styles / 65% visual learners
principles.generation_rule: No evidence style-matching helps; design for content type instead

principles.name: 8-second goldfish attention
principles.generation_rule: Untraceable stat; attention is task-dependent — use segmenting/contrast

principles.name: Generational learning needs
principles.generation_rule: No evidence; clarity+pacing help everyone

principles.name: Vendor 'X% more persuasive with visuals'
principles.generation_rule: Replace with Mayer/Alley effect sizes which are citable
